info.title: Kimi API (All Models) - Responses Full Reference
info.description:
Call Kimi text models through the OpenAI Responses protocol. Use `model` to select `kimi-k3.1-pro`, `kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed`, or `kimi-k3`. All have a context window of 1,048,576 tokens and support multi-turn conversations, streaming, tool calling, web search, structured output, and image input.

Reasoning is always enabled for all three models; adjust its intensity with `reasoning.effort`. Structured output and cache write TTL vary by model; see the `model` field. Preserve complete reasoning and tool-call history in multi-turn conversations.

post.description: Set reasoning effort with reasoning.effort and caching with prompt_cache_options. Search appears as web_search_call output items. For streaming, handle response.completed / response.incomplete / response.failed; hitting the output limit returns incomplete. Multi-turn requests must include the full output history, including reasoning, tool calls, and results.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get the weather for a specified city

value.input: Use web search to find the official Kimi homepage URL.
Return a JSON object with result equal to OK.

model.description:
Model to call:

| Model ID | Positioning | Reasoning effort |
|---|---|---|
| `kimi-k3.1-pro` | Latest-generation model (recommended) | `low` / `high` / `max`, default `max` |
| `kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed` | Same parameters as Pro, faster generation | Same as `kimi-k3.1-pro` |
| `kimi-k3` | Previous-generation model | Only `max` |

All three models have a context window of 1,048,576 tokens and always have reasoning enabled.

Structured output (`text.format`) and cache write TTL (`prompt_cache_options`) are supported only by the K3.1 series, not by `kimi-k3`.

input.description: Request input. A string is equivalent to one user message. An array contains typed items in order and may include conversation history, tool calls, and tool results.

instructions.description: Top-level system instructions, applied before all other instructions.

stream.description: When true, returns the response as an SSE stream.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens, including reasoning and the final answer. Default: 131072; maximum: 1048576, also limited by the remaining context.

effort.description:
Reasoning effort. Reasoning is always enabled.

- `kimi-k3.1-pro` / `kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed`: `low` / `high` / `max` are recommended; default `max`. For generic client compatibility, `medium` maps to `high`, `xhigh` to `max`, and `minimal` / `none` to `low`; `none` does not disable reasoning.
- `kimi-k3`: only `max` is supported (default).

Higher effort typically increases reasoning tokens and latency. Reasoning tokens count toward output.

format.description: Constrain the output structure with JSON Schema. Supported only by `kimi-k3.1-pro` / `kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed`; `kimi-k3` does not support it. For structured output with `kimi-k3`, use `response_format` in the Chat Completions API.

schema.description: JSON Schema describing the output structure.

strict.description: Whether to strictly enforce the schema.

tools.description: Tools that the model may call.

include.description: Additional fields to return, only for `web_search`. `web_search_call.action.sources` includes matched web sources; `web_search_call.results` includes image search results.

prompt_cache_options.description: Context cache write options, supported only by `kimi-k3.1-pro` / `kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed`; `kimi-k3` does not support this parameter. When omitted, a 5m cache is written automatically by default. Writes and reads are billed separately.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, fixed by the model at `1`; omit this field. `kimi-k3.1-pro` / `kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed` automatically ignore it; `kimi-k3` returns an error for unsupported values.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling threshold, fixed by the model at `0.95`; omit this field. `kimi-k3.1-pro` / `kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed` automatically ignore it; `kimi-k3` returns an error for unsupported values.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when the response was created.

completed_at.description: Unix timestamp when the response ended. Present when `status` is `completed` or `incomplete`; `null` for `in_progress` or `failed`.

status.description: Response status. The initial streaming snapshot has status `in_progress`.

output.description: Output item array, ordered as web_search_call (if any), reasoning, message, and tool calls.

prompt_cache_options.description: Context cache-write options actually applied by the server. If prompt_cache_options was omitted, use the mode and ttl returned here.

ResponsesStreamEvent.description: A single SSE event when `stream: true`. Each frame contains `event: <type>` and `data: <json>`; the remaining event-body fields depend on `type`.

sequence_number.description: Event sequence number, increasing monotonically from 0.

ResponsesInputItem.description: An input-array element, distinguished by `type`. If `type` is omitted, it is treated as `message`.

ResponsesTool.description: Tool definition, distinguished by `type`. Supports `function`, `custom` (only `apply_patch`), `namespace`, and `web_search`; other tool types are unsupported.

ResponsesToolChoice.description: Controls tool use. With `auto`, the model decides whether to call a tool.

ResponsesUsage.description: input_tokens includes cache reads and writes. For the K3.1 series, subtract cached_tokens and cache_write_tokens to obtain regular input; for `kimi-k3`, subtract only cached_tokens. output_tokens already includes reasoning.

input_tokens.description: Input token count, including cache hits.

cached_tokens.description: Tokens read from the context cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: Tokens written to the context cache.

output_tokens.description: Output token count, including reasoning tokens.

ResponsesMessageItem.title: Message
ResponsesMessageItem.description: A conversation message. `type` may be omitted.

role.description: Message role. `developer` is treated as system instructions.

content.description: Message content as a string or content-part array.

ResponsesReasoningItem.title: Reasoning
ResponsesReasoningItem.description: Replay reasoning from the previous turn. `content` takes precedence over `summary`.

call_id.description: Call ID paired with the corresponding `function_call_output`.

namespace.description: Tool namespace, returned for namespaced tool calls.

arguments.description: Function arguments as a JSON string.

ResponsesFunctionCallOutputItem.title: Function call result
ResponsesFunctionCallOutputItem.description: Execution result of a function call.

call_id.description: Same call ID as the corresponding `function_call`.
Call ID paired with the corresponding `custom_tool_call_output`.

namespace.description: Tool namespace, returned for namespaced tool calls.

input.description: Free-form text input generated by the model.

ResponsesCustomToolCallOutputItem.title: Custom tool call result
ResponsesCustomToolCallOutputItem.description: Execution result of a custom tool call.

call_id.description: Same call ID as the corresponding `custom_tool_call`.

ResponsesWebSearchCallItem.title: Web search call
ResponsesWebSearchCallItem.description: A previous web search record. Include it with the complete conversation history.

ResponsesAdditionalToolsItem.title: Dynamic tools
ResponsesAdditionalToolsItem.description: Add callable tools during a conversation, effective from this item's position onward.

ResponsesFunctionTool.title: Function tool
ResponsesFunctionTool.description: Function tool with parameters described by JSON Schema.

ResponsesCustomTool.title: Custom tool
ResponsesCustomTool.description: Custom tool accepting free-form text. Only a tool named `apply_patch` is supported, with a required `grammar` + `lark` format definition. Calls appear as `custom_tool_call` items in output.

format.description: Input-format constraints. Only type `grammar` with syntax `lark` is supported.

ResponsesNamespaceTool.title: Namespace tool
ResponsesNamespaceTool.description: Group function tools or custom tools under one namespace.

ResponsesWebSearchTool.title: Web search tool
ResponsesWebSearchTool.description: Web search tool, called when the model needs online information. Search records appear as web_search_call items. Declare at most one per request.

allowed_domains.description: Search only these domains, up to 100.

search_content_types.description: Search content types; defaults to `text` only. Including `image` also runs image search.

image_settings.description: Image search settings, only effective when `search_content_types` includes `image`.

ResponsesOutputFunctionCallItem.title: Function Call
ResponsesOutputFunctionCallItem.description: Function call initiated by the model.

call_id.description: Use this value in `function_call_output` when returning the result.

arguments.description: Function arguments as a JSON string.

ResponsesOutputCustomToolCallItem.title: Custom tool call
ResponsesOutputCustomToolCallItem.description: Custom tool call initiated by the model.

call_id.description: Use this value in `custom_tool_call_output` when returning the result.

input.description: Free-form text input generated by the model.

ResponsesOutputWebSearchCallItem.title: Web search call
ResponsesOutputWebSearchCallItem.description: Server-executed web search call. Returned only when the request includes `web_search` and the server decides to search; appears first in the output array.

sources.description: Matched web sources. Returned only when `include` contains `web_search_call.action.sources`.

results.description: Image search results. Returned only when `include` contains `web_search_call.results` and `search_content_types` contains `image`.

caption.description: Image caption, returned only when `image_settings.caption` is enabled.

image_url.description: Image data URL, such as `data:image/png;base64,<base64>`. Public http(s) URLs are unsupported.

oneOf.title: Output text
oneOf.description: Used to replay assistant text history.

bearerAuth.description:
##All APIs require Bearer Token authentication##

**Get API Key:**

Visit [API Key Management Page](https://evolink.ai/dashboard/keys) to get your API Key

**Add to request header:**
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```
